run_experiment.py.description: MockOAuthHandler, StreamingProxyHandler (read(STREAM_CHUNK_SIZE) loop streaming), BufferedProxyHandler (full buffering), high-entropy generators, iterative decompress_body max_depth=5

raw_cell_results.json.description: Per-cell observations 42 cells total: 24 multi-layer x2 chunk sizes, 12 regression, 6 identity; each observation streaming vs buffered hashes, sizes, headers, latencies

execution_context.architecture: StreamingProxy(stream_chunk_size 8192/32 incremental forwarding without full-body buffer) and BufferedProxy(full-body buffering re-chunk 32) -> MockOAuth2 Server (127.0.0.1) -> Client iterative decompression (brotli->gzip max_depth=5)
execution_context.streaming_proxy_detail: StreamingProxyHandler._proxy_request: HTTPConnection request -> getresponse -> send_response/headers -> loop while chunk=upstream_resp.read(STREAM_CHUNK_SIZE): wfile.write(chunked frame) without buffering full body
execution_context.buffered_proxy_detail: BufferedProxyHandler: upstream_resp.read() full buffer -> re-chunk at 32 bytes with chunked framing
execution_context.streaming_client_detail: make_request_streaming: requests.get(stream=True) -> loop resp.raw.read(stream_chunk_size) accumulate b''.join(chunks) -> decompress_body
execution_context.buffered_client_detail: make_request_buffered: requests.get(stream=True) -> resp.raw.read(decode_content=False) single read -> decompress_body
regression_controls: GZIP-SINGLE: gzip level None (default) at 10KB, chunk 8192 and 32
BROTLI-SINGLE: brotli quality 6 at 10KB, chunk 8192 and 32
identity_baselines: IDENTITY-10KB and IDENTITY-100KB high-entropy no compression via both proxies
execution_context.high_entropy_generators: generate_json_he_body (UUIDs, random floats, 5.49 bits/byte), generate_html_he_body (Wikipedia paragraphs, 4.66 bits/byte), generate_binary_he_body (structured random 7.69 bits/byte) — reused from EXP-RUNTIME-35495699298/35513777099, Shannon >=3.5
execution_context.total_observations_counting_both_paths: 480 streaming multi-layer +480 buffered multi-layer +240 regression streaming/buffered +120 identity streaming/buffered but metrics count unique HTTP requests 840
execution_context.ports: origin base 18700, stream proxy base 18800, buffered proxy base 18900
